leandro-erlich--the-building-liberty.why_en: Lie on a facade laid flat on the floor and a mirror overhead shows you hanging from a building.
leandro-erlich--the-building-liberty.why_zh: 躺在铺在地上的楼房立面上，头顶的大镜子里你就挂在了楼外墙上。

david-bowen--plant-drone.why_en: A living plant flies the drone, and its flight path is drawn in the night sky.
david-bowen--plant-drone.why_zh: 一株活的植物驾驶无人机，它的飞行轨迹被画在夜空里。

jr--eiffel-tower-trocadero.why_en: From one spot, a flat paper collage turns the ground into a cliff with the Eiffel Tower on its edge.
jr--eiffel-tower-trocadero.why_zh: 站在一个特定位置看，地上一张平面拼贴变成悬崖，埃菲尔铁塔就立在崖边。

jr--la-ferita.why_en: A paper tear in a closed museum's stone facade lets you see the halls inside.
jr--la-ferita.why_zh: 在闭馆博物馆的石墙上贴出一道“裂口”，让人看见里面的大厅。

satoshi-hattori--floor-pit.why_en: The real floor cracks into tiles and falls away, opening a pit under your feet.
satoshi-hattori--floor-pit.why_zh: 真实的地板碎成方块掉下去，脚下出现一个深坑。

christo-jeanne-claude--arc-de-triomphe-w.why_en: Wrapping a monument in fabric makes a familiar landmark look new.
christo-jeanne-claude--arc-de-triomphe-w.why_zh: 用布把纪念碑包起来，熟悉的地标一下子变得陌生。

koki-ibukuro--world-ensemble.why_en: Tap the buildings on a street and each one becomes an instrument in a song.
koki-ibukuro--world-ensemble.why_zh: 点一下街上的楼，每栋楼就成了一首曲子里的一件乐器。

satoshi-hattori--real-world-splatoon.why_en: Paint balls splat onto your real walls and furniture, as in Splatoon.
satoshi-hattori--real-world-splatoon.why_zh: 像 Splatoon 一样，把颜料弹打在自己房间真实的墙面和家具上。

skullmapping--rubens-cupid.why_en: A cupid escapes a Rubens painting, flies over travellers, and points to where the original hangs.
skullmapping--rubens-cupid.why_zh: 丘比特从 Rubens 的画里飞出来，掠过旅客头顶，再指向原作所在的地方。

rafael-lozano-hemmer--pulse-topology.why_en: Thousands of bulbs each flicker with a recorded heartbeat, so you walk through a landscape of pulses.
rafael-lozano-hemmer--pulse-topology.why_zh: 成千上万个灯泡各自随一段录下的心跳闪烁，人走在一片由脉搏组成的地形里。

xavi-bou--murmurations.why_en: Tracing every starling turns a flock into one moving sculpture in the sky.
xavi-bou--murmurations.why_zh: 把每只椋鸟的轨迹描出来，整个鸟群变成天空中一件流动的雕塑。

stephen-wilkes--this-fragile-earth-day-t.why_en: One photograph holds a whole day, from daylight on one side to night on the other.
stephen-wilkes--this-fragile-earth-day-t.why_zh: 一张照片装下一整天，一边是白昼，另一边是黑夜。

keijiro-takahashi--slitscancam.why_en: Each slice of the live image comes from a different moment, so moving people stretch through time.
keijiro-takahashi--slitscancam.why_zh: 实时画面的每一条切片来自不同时刻，走动的人被时间拉长、扭曲。

saype--beyond-walls.why_en: Giant painted hands clasp each other on grass, city after city, forming a chain around the world.
saype--beyond-walls.why_zh: 巨大的手在一座又一座城市的草地上彼此相握，连成一条环绕世界的链。

fujiko-nakaya--fog-sculpture-neue-nation.why_en: A sculpture made of fog that you walk into and that the wind keeps reshaping.
fujiko-nakaya--fog-sculpture-neue-nation.why_zh: 一件用雾做成的雕塑，人可以走进去，风不断改变它的形状。

maya-lin--ghost-forest.why_en: Trees killed by rising seas are planted in a Manhattan park, bringing a distant climate loss into the city.
maya-lin--ghost-forest.why_zh: 被海平面上升杀死的树被种进曼哈顿的公园，把远方的气候损失带进城市。
